tldr: Each webhook gets a payloadGeneration setting. An app sets IMMEDIATE to build a subscription payload in the request, not in a background task.
goal: Deferred payloads carry only the object's final state. Some apps apply each update in order, so they need the state at each request.

story.heading: Webhooks adds a per-webhook payload generation choice
story.body: Subscription webhooks on deferrable events build their payload now or in a background task.

story.heading: GraphQL API exposes payloadGeneration on webhooks
story.body: Webhook create and update mutations accept DEFERRED or IMMEDIATE. The default is DEFERRED.

story.heading: Webhook table stores the payload generation
story.body: Each webhook row stores its payload generation. Existing rows get deferred by default.

story.heading: Apps opt out of deferred payloads per webhook
story.body: An IMMEDIATE webhook builds its payload in the request. Other webhooks stay deferred.

components.summary: Adds WebhookPayloadGenerationEnum and a payloadGeneration field to webhook mutations and types.
Reads payloadGeneration from app manifests and sets DEFERRED when it is missing.
Splits subscription webhooks into deferred and immediate groups when it creates deliveries.

decisions.title: Let each webhook opt out of deferred payloads
decisions.why: Some apps apply updates in sequence. Deferred payloads carry only the final state, so those apps need immediate payloads.
decisions.alternative: Turn deferral off for all webhooks

decisions.title: Read the setting once when deliveries are created
decisions.why: Later changes to the setting do not affect deliveries that already exist.

flows.title: Notify apps about an order update
